tool_input.description: Inspect JSON run history structure and check for GitLab CLI

result:
- **Cause:** Not this MR. `Receipt_RendersBatch_WithinTimeBudget` is a wall-clock test that only fails on runner-06, and it fails there on `main` at the untouched commit `32f21f2` too (4 failures, all on that one machine, all today). The same gift-message commit `9195843` passed on runner-06 in ~90 ms in another run and in 64 ms locally. The failing runs took 5–6x longer, which points to runner-06 being overloaded or short on cores at the time; the gift-message change only adds a null check to the render path.

- **Action:** Changed nothing. A code fix would not address the cause, and raising the 250 ms budget would only weaken the check to suit one slow runner. The pipeline is still red: this repo has no git remote configured, so I could not retry the job from here.

To get it green, retry the `test` job on MR !48:

```
glab ci retry test
```

If it lands on runner-06 again it may fail again, so someone should look at that runner (load, CPU allocation) or pause it, since it is also failing `main`.
